title: Joined data buffers reach the destination byte for byte
summary: The merged synchronous writer traversed every component, including when the destination accepted one byte at a time.

change.description: The two-commit landing changes synchronous channel traversal and asynchronous file-write callbacks. Both paths must finish every component of a joined buffer.

notes: The caller counts the readable components before writing, releases the emitted buffer, closes the channel and independently reads the destination file.
